lines.text: **To Patrick Pesnot,** who taught us that History
can also be told in a low voice.
**To Kaarlo Tuomi,** who ended up telling his story.
This story is fiction built on real facts.
The dialogue is imagined; the facts have been checked,
and anything resting on a single source is flagged as such.
Real people still living are never shown

lines.para: Main sources: Patrick Pesnot’s France Inter programme on Kaarlo Tuomi, broadcast on 1 January and 16 July 2005; Kaarlo Tuomi, “Spy Lost” (Enigma Books, 2014); FBI files on Operation “Ghost Stories”; the British counter-terrorism police timeline of Salisbury; press of the time.
